description:
**Job Title**  
Operations Manager

**The Practical Detail**  
Location: Bangalore, India  
Working Model: Hybrid  
Contract Type: Fulltime

**Why this role matters**  
In your first year as Operations Manager, you will lead the delivery of Bill-to-Cash and Procure-to-Pay operations for the LATAM market, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and service excellence. This role is vital to Flora Food Group's finance function, enabling smooth cash flow and supplier relationships that support our mission to put better food on tables worldwide. By driving operational performance and continuous improvement, you help maintain the financial health that powers our kitchens and consumers.

**What you'll do**

* Lead end-to-end Bill-to-Cash and Procure-to-Pay processes, ensuring compliance with service level agreements and key performance indicators.
* Manage daily operational performance, prioritizing workloads to maintain business continuity and resolve issues promptly.
* Coach and develop a team of 8–10 finance operations professionals, fostering a culture of high performance and engagement.
* Build strong relationships with market finance teams and business stakeholders to improve process efficiency and customer experience.
* Drive process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives using digital tools like SAP and Serrala.

**Performance**  
You will own key metrics such as Days Sales Outstanding, billing accuracy, claims aging, and cash application accuracy, using data to identify and implement improvements. Your leadership will ensure consistent delivery within agreed SLAs, reduce operational risks, and enhance productivity. Your results will directly impact Flora Food Group's financial stability and operational excellence.

**Care**  
Reporting to the Finance GBS leadership, you will lead a medium-sized team and collaborate closely with Sales, Customer Service, Commercial Finance, and Finance Controls. You will uphold strong governance, compliance, and risk management standards, ensuring long-term sustainability and trust across the business. Your role supports a culture of accountability and continuous learning that benefits both your team and the wider organization.

**Passion**  
You bring a genuine interest in finance operations that support the food industry's complex supply chains. Your curiosity about process innovation and automation reflects Flora Food Group's commitment to reliability and functionality in every transaction. You take pride in delivering precise, timely financial services that enable the creation and distribution of better food.

**About you**  
You have extensive experience in collections, accounts receivable, or order-to-cash processes within global business services or shared services environments. You demonstrate strong leadership in managing operational teams and driving performance improvements. Your approach is data-driven, detail-oriented, and focused on delivering measurable business outcomes. You communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders and thrive in a global, fast-evolving environment.

You take pride in working for a company with over 150 years of expertise in food, and you understand that excellent work in every function is what allows Flora Food Group to put better food on tables around the world. You bring the same rigour and care to your discipline that our teams bring to every product, because how we work is as important as what we make.

This role typically leads to senior leadership positions within finance operations or broader finance functions, offering opportunities to influence global finance strategy and transformation. Growth usually occurs over several years as you deepen your expertise and expand your leadership impact.

If this opportunity sounds exciting, we'd love to hear from you.

***Job Description: Team Lead – Medical Insurance Operations***

**Location:** Bengaluru  
**Experience:** 3–5 Years  
**Qualification:** MBBS / BHMS / BAMS  
**Work Schedule:** 5 Days a Week | Rotational Shifts  
**Industry:** Health Insurance / TPA / Healthcare Operations

***Job Summary***

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented **Team Lead – Medical Insurance Operations** to manage daily operational activities, team performance, inventory allocation, and medical case processing.

The ideal candidate should have 3–5 years of relevant experience in health insurance, TPA operations, claims processing, and/or pre-authorization. This role requires a hands-on medical professional who can effectively manage team operations while independently handling medical cases, with approximately 50% of the role dedicated to individual case processing.

***Key Responsibilities***

* Manage day-to-day team operations and ensure achievement of productivity, quality, and turnaround time (TAT) targets.
* Monitor incoming inventory, allocate cases, manage pending workloads, and ensure timely case processing.
* Independently handle claims and/or pre-authorization cases, dedicating approximately 50% of working time to individual processing.
* Review medical records, clinical documentation, treatment plans, and supporting documents to assess medical admissibility in accordance with policy terms and client guidelines.
* Provide medical and process-related guidance to team members and assist in resolving complex cases.
* Monitor individual and team performance, identify productivity gaps, and implement corrective action plans.
* Ensure compliance with SOPs, client guidelines, insurance policy terms, quality standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Monitor ageing cases, prioritise TAT-critical inventory, and proactively prevent SLA breaches.
* Manage operational escalations and coordinate with internal stakeholders for timely resolution.
* Conduct team huddles, knowledge-sharing sessions, and refresher training to improve processing accuracy and productivity.
* Analyse quality errors and recurring issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Prepare and maintain daily reports on productivity, quality, TAT, inventory, and pending cases.
* Identify process improvement opportunities to enhance operational efficiency and service delivery.

***Required Qualifications and Experience***

* MBBS / BHMS / BAMS from a recognised institution.
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in health insurance, TPA operations, claims processing, or pre-authorization.
* Prior experience in team coordination, floor support, mentoring, or team handling is preferred.
* Sound understanding of medical documentation, medical necessity, policy benefits, exclusions, and insurance processing guidelines.
* Experience in productivity monitoring, inventory management, quality control, and TAT/SLA adherence.

***Required Skills***

* Strong medical assessment, analytical, and decision-making skills.
* Team management, mentoring, and work allocation.
* Inventory, backlog, and workload management.
* Excellent problem-solving and escalation-handling abilities.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and operational reporting.
* Ability to work in a target-driven environment while maintaining quality standards.
* Flexibility to work in rotational shifts based on business requirements.

***What We Are Looking For***

A hands-on medical professional with strong operational ownership, proven team coordination abilities, and a commitment to delivering high productivity, processing accuracy, quality, and service excellence.

**Screening \& Monitoring**

* Financial Loss

title: Centre Manager
description:
Centre Manager – Ayurveda Clinic

**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 2–5 years  
**Industry:** Healthcare / Ayurveda

About the Role

We are looking for a **Centre Manager** to manage the overall operations and business performance of our Ayurveda clinic. The role will involve managing the **front desk, pharmacy, staff, patient experience, daily operations and centre revenue**.

The ideal candidate should be a hands\-on manager with strong communication, people\-management and business\-development skills.

Key Responsibilities

**Centre Operations**

* Manage the day\-to\-day operations of the clinic.
* Ensure smooth coordination between doctors, therapists, front office, pharmacy and housekeeping.
* Ensure adherence to clinic SOPs, quality standards and operational processes.

**Front Desk \& Patient Management**

* Manage appointments, registrations, billing and patient coordination.
* Monitor patient footfall, follow\-ups and conversions.
* Ensure a professional and positive patient experience.
* Handle patient queries and resolve operational complaints.

**Pharmacy \& Inventory**

* Manage day\-to\-day pharmacy operations and inventory.
* Monitor stock levels, expiry and stock movement.
* Ensure timely procurement and minimise stock\-outs.
* Conduct regular stock reconciliation.

**Staff Management**

* Prepare staff duty rosters and manage daily manpower requirements.
* Monitor attendance, punctuality and staff productivity.
* Allocate responsibilities and ensure adequate staffing.
* Conduct regular team briefings and coordinate staff training.

**Business \& Revenue**

* Take ownership of the centre's monthly revenue and business targets.
* Monitor consultations, therapies, pharmacy sales and collections.
* Track leads, conversions, follow\-ups and repeat patients.
* Identify opportunities to increase patient visits and centre revenue.
* Support local marketing, referral and business\-development initiatives.

**Administration \& Reporting**

* Monitor daily collections and ensure proper reconciliation.
* Maintain centre reports, registers and operational records.
* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly MIS reports.
* Coordinate with management, accounts, HR, procurement and marketing teams.

Key Performance Areas

* Centre Revenue \& Business Growth
* Patient Footfall \& Retention
* Consultation \& Therapy Conversion
* Pharmacy Sales \& Inventory Management
* Staff Productivity \& Attendance
* Patient Experience
* Operational \& SOP Compliance

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in **Healthcare Management, Hospital Administration, Business Administration, Ayurveda, Life Sciences** or a related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in **clinic, hospital, Ayurveda, wellness or healthcare operations**.
* Strong communication and team\-management skills.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets and basic reporting.
* Ability to manage multiple functions independently.
* Prior experience in Ayurveda/healthcare operations will be an advantage.

What We Are Looking For

A **hands\-on Centre Manager** who can independently manage the clinic's **people, patients, pharmacy, operations and business**, while maintaining a high standard of patient experience.

Pay: From ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person
